lines.speaker: Elend Venture
lines.text: Valette? It's past midnight. If my father's steward catches you in here we'll both be in a great deal of trouble — him mostly with me, for once.

lines.speaker: Vin
lines.text: I needed somewhere quiet. And you always seem to know where the old books are.

choices.text: Tell him the truth: you're skaa, and you were part of Kelsier's crew.
Keep the mask: you're only a noblewoman shaken by the executions.

lines.speaker: Elend Venture
lines.text: Skaa. And a thief's apprentice. I... should be angry. I think I'm mostly embarrassed that I didn't see it. You never did hold a teacup correctly.

lines.speaker: Elend Venture
lines.text: My father is pulling House Venture out of the city before the season ends. He thinks Luthadel is about to burn, and he'd like to be somewhere comfortable while it does.

lines.speaker: Elend Venture
lines.text: I'm not going with him. If this city is going to change, someone with a noble name ought to be standing in it, arguing that the skaa deserve a say in what comes next. Even if nobody listens yet.

lines.speaker: Elend Venture
lines.text: The executions. Yes. Half the court went to watch as if it were a play. I went because I thought someone should look at it honestly.

lines.speaker: Elend Venture
lines.text: My father is taking House Venture out of the city. I've decided to stay. Someone in this family should be here when the city finally asks its questions out loud.

lines.speaker: Elend Venture
lines.text: If you're hunting for something in these shelves — and you are, you have the look — try the gallery. My grandfather annotated everything he read, usually rudely, and his ink has faded almost to nothing.
